name: memhop-guide
summary: MemHop 记忆系统总说明书：Search 回忆并存储、Update 回写回复、Dream 巩固、L6 轨迹结晶为 L5 能力的完整循环（宿主通过 api 包直接调用）
trigger: 使用 memhop 记忆数据库，或不确定该调用哪个 MemHop API 时；memhop memory guide 入门 指南

resources.name: Search
resources.desc: 每轮收到用户消息时调用：检索相关记忆并把本条消息写入 L2 主题与 L4 档案；用返回的 Profile/ProfileBrief/Contexts/AssociatedContexts 组装提示上下文
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string","description":"用户消息原文"},"timestamp":{"type":"integer","description":"Unix 毫秒"},"auto_create":{"type":"boolean","description":"跳过检索直建新话题（可选）"},"directed_l2_id":{"type":"string","description":"定向写入指定场景（可选）"},"directed_l3_id":{"type":"string","description":"限定知识图谱范围（可选）"}},"required":["text","timestamp"]}

resources.name: Update
resources.desc: 每次生成回复后调用：把回复追加到 Search 返回的 NewTopicID
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"topic_id":{"type":"string","description":"Search 返回的 NewTopicID（16 位 hex）"},"text":{"type":"string","description":"Agent 回复原文"},"timestamp":{"type":"integer","description":"Unix 毫秒"}},"required":["topic_id","text","timestamp"]}

resources.name: Dream
resources.desc: 空闲期/固定周期调用：巩固记忆（L2 压缩、L1 衰减、L0 画像蒸馏）
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"scene_id":{"type":"string","description":"指定场景 ID（16 位 hex，空串巩固全部活跃场景）"}},"required":["scene_id"]}
resources.output: bool（是否有活跃场景被巩固）

resources.name: Crystallize
resources.desc: 轨迹积累后调用：把 L6 操作轨迹结晶为 L5 能力草稿，宿主激活后复用

steps.action: 每轮对话开始：回忆并存储用户消息
每轮对话结束：回写 Agent 回复
轨迹充足时：结晶可复用能力
